description: minimumReleaseAge matches pnpm's default (minimumReleaseAge 1440 min, since pnpm 11): a version younger than a day is not resolvable, so a PR for one would fail its lockfile update.

packageRules.description: googleapis-common must stay on the exact range googleapis depends on (it pins google-auth-library to an exact version, so a second copy breaks the Drive client's JWT type; see #3444, #3445). Bump it by hand only when googleapis moves to a new googleapis-common major.
